title: Dos and Don'ts / graphic contrast and coexistence
slide_intent: Protect separation between identity elements so their forms remain understandable.
strategic_value: Clear contrast and restrained combinations can prevent DB’s bar-derived elements from competing.
demonstration: A red heart on a light background is paired with a crossed-out dark heart over strong red bars.
practical_value: Preserve contrast and follow this checklist’s subtle-background exception, noting the conflicting earlier paragraph.

content_islands.name: Positive example
content_islands.spec: Show the red heart clearly separated from its light background.

content_islands.name: Negative example
content_islands.spec: Cross out the competing heart and strong Schwelle combination.

reference_purposes.Application: The pair makes the competing forms visible.
reference_purposes.Constraint: This checklist prohibits signature graphics with other Schwelle forms except a subtle-background Schwelle; the earlier illustrative-Schwelle paragraph is less restrictive.
